summary: Completed testing of FamFocus Hub Iteration 7 - Battery Percentage Feature. All 19 backend tests passed. Frontend battery indicator and permission toggle working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Battery endpoints properly validate level (0-100 range)
Battery sharing is permission-based - child must enable it first
Low battery notification (<=15%) only triggers when NOT charging
Parent dashboard shows battery indicator with color coding (green/yellow/red)
Battery toggle in child Settings page works correctly with toast feedback
seed_data_creation: Alex has battery sharing enabled with 45% battery level
context_for_next_testing_agent: Battery percentage feature fully tested. All 4 battery endpoints working. Parent dashboard shows battery indicator on child cards. Child Settings page has Privacy & Permissions section with battery toggle.

features: POST /api/battery/update - Updates child's battery status
Validates battery level (0-100 range)
Rejects negative or >100 values with 400 error
Returns success:false if battery sharing not enabled
Stores battery level, is_charging, and updated_at timestamp
GET /api/battery/family - Returns battery status for all children
Only accessible by parents (403 for children)
Returns user_id, name, picture, level, is_charging, updated_at, is_stale
Only includes children with share_battery permission enabled
PUT /api/permissions/battery - Toggle battery sharing permission
Returns success:true and share_battery value
Persists permission in user's permissions object
GET /api/permissions - Get user's permission settings
Returns permissions object with share_battery field
Works for both parents and children
Creates notification when battery <= 15% and NOT charging
Notification type is 'battery_low'
Message includes child's name and battery percentage
No notification created when charging even if low
Battery indicator shows on child cards
Shows battery percentage (e.g., 45%)
Color coding: green (>30%), yellow (15-30%), red (<=15%)
Shows charging icon when charging
Only shows for children with battery sharing enabled
Privacy & Permissions section visible for children
Current Battery status display (from Browser Battery API)
Share Battery with Parents toggle
Toggle shows green when enabled, gray when disabled
Toast notification on toggle change
Helpful text explaining the feature

child_settings: Current Battery status with progress bar

mocked_apis.note: No mocked APIs - all integrations are real
